author: reek
body: Smoke test for nRF9160 board drivers. MMIO stubs return 0, so this exercises driver logic without real hardware or a live cellular network. AT commands are tested as string builders.

author: reek
body: The AT command builders and the AT response parsers are pure text work, so they stay bound with plain lets. If someone gives one of them a register access later, those lines stop compiling.
